title: Implementation Phases Roadmap
lede: Five sequential development phases structuring the evolutionary simulation from foundational grid physics to neuroevolutionary analytics.

phases.name: Environment & Movement Mechanics
goals: Construct 25x25 discrete Cartesian grid world model.
Implement procedural biome distributions: Plains (60%), Forest (25%), Water (10%), Mountains (5%).
Build neighbor-aware entity spawning avoiding turn-0 agent collisions.
Verify terrain movement cost penalties and directional pathing.

phases.name: Biological Needs & Species Archetypes
goals: Implement status variables: Health, Hunger, Thirst, Energy, Instinct.
Model metabolic depletion: Hunger (-5/turn), Thirst (-8/turn), and Starvation damage.
Define Herbivore, Carnivore, and Omnivore species specializations.
Equip category passives: Ambush Predator (1.5x damage) and Efficient Grazer (1.25x plant gain).

phases.name: Event System & Environmental Disasters
goals: Deploy scheduled weekly natural disaster system (Wildfire, Blizzard, Flash Flood).
Implement stochastic difficulty check mechanics using d10 dice roll formulas.
Establish localized situational triggers (Rockslides, Contaminated Water, Ancient Relics).
Balance disaster survival odds across varied animal traits.

phases.name: Neuroevolution & Evolutionary Algorithm
goals: Construct 41-16-12-8 Multi-Layer Perceptron neural network architecture.
Normalize 3x3 sensory grid perception inputs and internal vitals into neural vectors.
Implement multivariable Fitness Function rewarding survival time, food, kills, and exploration.
Execute generational breeding: Elitism (top 10%), crossover, and Gaussian weight mutation.

phases.name: Visualization, GUI & Scientific Analytics
goals: Build real-time Pygame graphical interface displaying grid tiles, entities, and vitals.
Implement generational telemetry logging tracking average fitness, lifespan, and kill rates.
Deliver interactive documentation monograph and simulation control dashboard.
